Name: CP Lumina Pumpkin Crop
Author: yourdorkbrains
Description:
Adds a white/pink pumpkin in game and a recipe to be made as well stuffed lumina pumpkins unlocked at level 3 farming.

Since its a vegetable you can put it in the keg or preserves jar to get pickled lumina pumpkin and lumina pumpkin juice.

I  made this one able to grow in spring and fall (Mostly because it matches my farm aesthetics :P)

Is just like a regular pumpkin same price (will add gift tastes once I figure it out).

You can buy seeds for 100 gold from Pierre.


Commissioned from [url=https://coincrown.carrd.co/]Coin Crown[/url], who I thank very much! <3

Used game sprites of regular pumpkin for crop stages edited colors a bit to match pumpkin.
